title: Attribute SRD invocation option source pages (48-50)
description:
Split from eshyra-vk23.3 (prerequisite parsing fix). The prerequisite-truncation bug is fixed; this bead covers the remaining source-page attribution.

Problem:
All 32 Warlock Eldritch Invocation options in feature:warlock:eldritch-invocations carry source 'SRD 5.1 p. 47' (the feature heading page). The invocation list actually spans SRD pages 48-50 (p.47 holds only the intro paragraph). Evidence from the vendored PDF text:
- p.48: Agonizing Blast, Armor of Shadows, Ascendant Step, Beast Speech, Beguiling Influence, Bewitching Whispers, Book of Ancient Secrets (start).
- p.49: Chains of Carceri, Lifedrinker, Master of Myriad Forms, Minions of Chaos, Mire the Mind, Repelling Blast, etc.
- p.50: Thirsting Blade, Visions of Distant Realms, Voice of the Chain Master, Whispers of the Grave, Witch Sight, etc.

Why deferred (per docs/importer-fix-protocol.md stop-and-report rule):
Per-option page attribution needs a NEW extractor strategy, not a localized parser fix. The options are parsed in deriveFeatureChoices.ts from the already-concatenated feature.description string, which carries no page data. The warlock pages are a TWO-COLUMN layout where invocation headings interleave with Pact Boon text; parseFeatures de-interleaves columns to build the description, so recovering a per-heading page number requires threading page-boundary data from extract.ts/parseFeatures through FeatureExtraction into the choice deriver.

Scope:
- Capture the source page for each invocation heading at parse time (column-aware).
- Thread a heading->page map on FeatureExtraction (or emit per-option source at parse time).
- Set each option's source to its true SRD page (48, 49, or 50).
- Regression test: assert representative options resolve to 48/49/50, not all 47.

Acceptance:
- Invocation option sources reflect SRD pages 48-50, not a single collapsed p.47.
- verify:dnd5e-srd-pack passes; typecheck/test/check pass.

Likely files: packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseFeatures.ts, extract.ts, types.ts (FeatureExtraction), deriveFeatureChoices.ts, emit.ts.
close_reason: Completed in branch eshyra-vk23-rest: gameplay-readiness partial-structure reporting, clean Biome 2.5.1 check output, and SRD option source-page attribution.
